contextual_inputs.relationship: non-task-graph contextual input; MC-016 routes independent-consumer blockers to MC-017

hypothesis: A downstream STEP path is a credible independent consumer candidate only when it consumes the exact exported STEP bytes, uses a decisive import/solid-analysis stack outside the known OCCT/Manifold producer families, reports bounded observables under explicit error controls, and can perform a follow-on operation on the imported geometry itself.
falsification: the path shares decisive OCCT/Open CASCADE or Manifold geometry with the producer-side candidate
the path measures the producer's in-memory B-rep instead of the exported STEP file
repaired, inferred, partial or invalid-preserved import is counted as success
positive-volume material, durable bodies or lineage are dropped or fused for consumer convenience
an exact-zero contact is healed or an empty state is replaced by invented residual material
ray-grid or other approximate measurement is labelled exact or used outside its demonstrated error budget
the claimed follow-on engineering operation does not consume the independently imported geometry

source_level_candidate.name: BRL-CAD step-g + BRL-CAD database/analysis stack

observed_source_facts.gqa_method: progressively refined ray grids with a configured lower spacing limit

source_level_candidate.independence_scope: Source inspection establishes a credible direct-stack alternative to the known OCCT/Manifold producer families. It is not a complete transitive dependency audit and is not measured native interoperability evidence.

import.command_template: step-g --strict --exact --repair none --reject-invalid-objs --report IMPORT.json --summary SUMMARY.csv -o OUTPUT.g INPUT.step

controls_required_before_native_qualific.requirement: A separately sourced conventional solid with independently known body count, coarse dimensions and volume must import completely under the same strict policy.
A malformed, unsupported or deliberately incomplete control must fail or report non-complete under the same strict policy; repair/partial publication may not rescue it.
When a source-bound STEP instance exists for the preserved RCS-011 valid-but-materially-wrong case, consumer validity alone must not convert it into material correctness.

observables: body/object inventory from import report and database
measurement.micro_feature_rule: No positive micro-feature or exact-zero boundary is qualified by gqa unless the complete MC-1 error budget and sampling/discrimination argument explicitly covers that feature.

follow_on_operation.operation: Create a new BRL-CAD-native probe cutter and evaluate a Boolean difference whose retained operand is the independently imported STEP object; re-run inventory/measurement on the result.
follow_on_operation.acceptance: The operation must complete without replacing the imported object by producer authority, and the measured coarse material change must match an independently derived control within the declared measurement error budget.

profile_semantics.consumer_rule: strict complete import; no repair/inference; body inventory and measurement required
must preserve void topology and pass independent measurement; RB-016-01 remains open
all durable bodies must survive as distinct material objects with source-bound mapping; RB-016-02 remains open
approximate ray-grid measurement is insufficient by itself; RB-016-03 remains open
no healing/fusion; consume the versioned MC-054 profile decision before qualification; RB-016-04 remains open
explicit empty outcome only; no fake epsilon solid or nonempty placeholder; RB-016-05 remains open

blockers.summary: The BRL-CAD path is source-viable, but no explicit native-execution permit/expensive-campaign lock or pre-existing source-bound MC-1 STEP-through-BRL-CAD result is available in this task, so import, measurement and follow-on engineering use cannot be claimed as observed evidence.
blockers.why_not_solved_here: The MC-1 execution protocol explicitly separates cheap contract verification from native execution and states that readiness does not authorize expenditure or native campaigns. MC-017 therefore records the executable protocol and defers measured qualification rather than fabricating access.
